name: Donorfy
shortDescription: A UK charity CRM for supporter records, donations, Gift Aid, online forms, payments, fundraising reporting and integrations.
company: Donorfy Limited (part of Access UK Ltd)
suitableContexts: Church charities with substantial donor, campaign or fundraising data
Teams needing Gift Aid alongside supporter relationship management
Churches using several fundraising and payment platforms that need CRM integration

pricing.summary: Donorfy charges by peak constituent count and edition rather than per user or module. The public pricing page includes monthly, annual and multi-year payment options, but the reviewed results do not expose all live band prices; use the supplier's live calculator and obtain implementation, VAT, migration, integration and commitment costs in writing.

tiers.label: Starter, Professional and Enterprise
tiers.detail: Supplier states that pricing depends on edition and peak number of active or archived constituents.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier states that no payment information is required for its free trial.

gdprInformation: Donorfy publishes terms, a data-processing agreement, data-protection material, security information and a sub-processor list. Its public materials state it acts as processor for customer data in the relevant arrangement. A church should still review its edition, hosting, enabled forms, integrations, payment providers, sub-processors, retention, access roles, exports and international transfers before importing supporter or pastoral information.
coreFeatures: Gift Aid eligibility and HMRC integration
integrations: Confirm current integration scope, data mapping and charges
importExport: Accounts-system exports described, including QuickBooks, Sage and Xero options by edition
Request complete constituent, donation, Gift Aid declaration, form, consent, attachment, audit-trail and configuration export documentation
support: Supplier lists Donorfy Academy, knowledge base and customer support
Professional implementation packages are stated to take four to ten weeks
Confirm support hours, response commitments and migration scope

uk-operator.value: Companies House records DONORFY LIMITED (08922148), and the company's filing history records Access UK Ltd as its person with significant control from November 2024.

hmrc-recognition.value: HMRC's current commercial Charities Online supplier list names Donorfy Ltd and Donorfy.

product-and-pricing.value: Supplier documents constituent-volume pricing, Gift Aid HMRC integration, payment options, implementation packages and standard integrations.

data-processing.value: Supplier publishes terms that incorporate a data-processing agreement and privacy notice, plus separate data-protection and security material.

editorial.assessment: Donorfy is a substantial UK charity CRM and fundraising system, not a church-specific ministry platform. It becomes relevant where a church charity needs sophisticated supporter, campaign, donor and Gift Aid processes beyond a simple giving form. Its volume-based commercial model and wider CRM capability may be disproportionate for a small congregation, and it should not be used as a substitute for safeguarding-case controls or a general congregation and ministry database without a role-led evaluation.
bestFor: Church charities with significant fundraising, supporter and Gift Aid workflows
Multi-channel donors and campaigns needing CRM, payment and reporting connections
Larger teams able to manage a structured CRM implementation
strengths: Active UK supplier with current HMRC Charities Online listing
Gift Aid integration included on stated core editions
limitations: General charity CRM rather than purpose-built church-management software
All current price bands and implementation costs are not visible in reviewed search material
Constituent volume includes archived records, which affects cost
Churches must separately assess ministry, safeguarding, pastoral and consent workflows

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing fundraising, donors and Gift Aid across several tools without losing relationship and financial history
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity CRM with established Gift Aid, fundraising and payment integrations
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use a demonstration and sandbox to test a real campaign-to-Gift-Aid-to-accounts workflow; model peak constituent pricing, request migration and export evidence, and review DPA, sub-processors and access roles before moving supporter records
